purpose: Experiment E-SPN-0044 in the spin arena: the committed rule does not carry the spinor sign: the coin directions are a 2T torsor on which the 2 pi turn of $SU(2)_L$ is the point inversion, the rule's own turn lifts after four steps to that 2 pi turn in $SU(2)_L$ alone, the palindromic schedule retraces it to a net lift of +1 where the rejected cyclic schedule nets -1, and the point inversion is no symmetry of the rule except joined to charge conjugation and time reversal, so a lone love and its 2 pi image run different histories.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
